verdict.rationale: llama.cpp lets users converse with loaded models in natural language through `llama cli`, the `llama serve` web UI, and VLM chat sessions (gh-1, gh-2, gh-3, gh-4, comm-13). However, operating the tool itself (choosing and loading models, configuration, server control) is done through CLI flags and slash commands like '/image', not natural-language instructions. missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's own operations (model management, configuration, server actions), any documented agentic or NL command mode, independent corroboration of NL-driven operation
